Job Title: Electrical Engineer / Senior Electrical Engineer Location: Andheri Airport / Commercial Facility / Infrastructure Project Role Purpose Responsible for the operation, maintenance, execution, and lifecycle management of electrical and electromechanical systems across the facility. The role involves ensuring uninterrupted services, managing project execution, maintaining statutory compliance, and adhering to all safety standards and SOPs. Key Responsibilities Electrical Operations & Maintenance Operate and maintain HT/LT electrical systems and associated infrastructure. Ensure preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of electrical equipment. Monitor system performance and ensure maximum equipment uptime. Troubleshoot electrical faults and implement corrective actions. Mechanical & Utility Systems Handle electrical aspects of mechanical installations including: Vertical Transportation Systems (VHT - Elevators & Escalators) Pumps Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) Building Handling System (BHS) Water Supply & Utility Systems HVAC electrical interfaces Coordinate with OEMs and maintenance contractors for critical systems. Projects & Execution Prepare cost estimates, BOQs, technical specifications, and project documentation. Execute electrical projects from planning to commission. Monitor project schedules, budgets, quality, and contractor performance. Manage the complete project lifecycle, including installation, testing, commissioning, handover, and warranty support. Coordinate with internal stakeholders, consultants, and vendors for timely project delivery. Compliance & Safety Ensure compliance with statutory electrical regulations, safety standards, and company policies. Implement and monitor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments. Ensure adherence to permit-to-work systems and electrical safety protocols. Support internal and external audits. Documentation & Reporting Maintain maintenance records, equipment history, inspection reports, and project documentation. Prepare MIS reports, maintenance schedules, and project status updates. Ensure proper inventory management of electrical spares and consumables. Required Skills Strong knowledge of electrical systems, HT/LT distribution, transformers, DG sets, UPS, panels, and switchgear. Good exposure to mechanical utility systems such as VHT, Pumps, STP, BHS, HVAC, and related installations. Experience in project estimation, budgeting, BOQ preparation, and lifecycle project management. Knowledge of electrical safety regulations, statutory compliance, and SOP implementation. Ability to troubleshoot electrical and electromechanical systems. Strong coordination, planning, and vendor management skills. Proficiency in MS Office, AutoCAD (preferred), and maintenance management systems (CMMS/BMS). Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering. Valid Electrical Supervisor License (preferred, where applicable). Experience 5 to 10 years of experience in electrical maintenance and project execution. Experience in airports, commercial buildings, industrial facilities, infrastructure projects, or facility management is preferred. Hands-on experience with estimation, project execution, lifecycle delivery, and utility management.

title: SAP ABAP Sr Technical Developer Analyst-I
description:
Job Summary 
 A Day in Your Life at MKS At MKS, we are looking for a Sr. SAP Business Analyst - Sales Distribution (SD) and Order Management (OM) to join our SAP Enhancements Team and play a key role in continuously improving and transforming our global SAP landscape. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand their needs, assess enhancement requests, perform impact analysis, and translate business requirements into effective SAP solutions. You will collaborate with Business Process Owners, super users, end users, functional teams, technical teams, enterprise architecture, integration teams, and external partners to deliver high-value SAP enhancements and continuous improvements. Your day may include reviewing new enhancement demands, facilitating requirement discussions, analyzing O2C processes, designing SAP solutions, working with developers on implementation, reviewing test results, resolving functional defects, participating in sprint ceremonies, and engaging stakeholders on delivery status and priorities. You will also be expected to proactively identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate manual activities, improve user experience, automate business processes, and leverage new SAP capabilities and emerging technologies. As part of the SAP Enhancements Team, you will gain broad exposure to multiple SAP ERP landscapes, business processes, applications, integrations, and stakeholders across MKS, providing an opportunity to grow beyond traditional functional support into end-to-end solution ownership and business transformation. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 1. SAP ABAP Development Enhancement 
 Work on SAP ABAP enhancement development from requirement analysis through design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Develop and maintain complex WRICEF objects including Reports, Workflows, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms. Perform technical impact analysis, estimation, debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance optimization. Follow SAP coding standards, development best practices, and quality guidelines. 
 
 2. Technical Expertise Solution Design 
 Strong hands-on experience in ABAP, ABAP Objects/OOPs, Classes, BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, Implicit Enhancements, Function Modules, and DDIC. Experience with Workflows, Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, Interfaces, Proxies, DMEE, Search Helps, CDS Views, AMDP, Table Functions, and ABAP on HANA. Design scalable technical solutions and collaborate with functional consultants, architects, business users, and other IT teams. Knowledge of SAP Finance /Logistics/Operations is a strong advantage. 
 
 3. Testing, Production Support Delivery 
 Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect resolution, deployment, and production issue resolution. Perform code reviews and ensure performance, quality, security, and maintainability of ABAP developments. Participate in Agile/Scrum activities including estimation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and delivery tracking. 
 
 4. Collaboration Technical Leadership 
 Collaborate effectively with business end users, functional consultants, developers, architects, and testing teams. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior ABAP developers. Communicate technical solutions, risks, dependencies, and recommendations effectively. 
 
 Skills You Bring 
 
 Required Skills 
 SAP ABAP development ABAP Objects/OOPs BAPIs BADIs User Exits Implicit Enhancements WRICEF Adobe Forms Smart Forms 
 
 Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills 
 OData and SAP Fiori - good to have but not mandatory. SAP S/4HANA and modern ABAP development. SAP Certification. Experience with ServiceNow/Jira. Exposure to automation, AI-enabled SAP solutions, or SAP BTP. Experience working in a global organization with multiple SAP landscapes.
